protocol: Keep the original five canonical and three separate holdout subjects and parameter matrix unchanged.
Query references at every commands.* and executors.* declaration, including unused declarations. Query positions from YAML are not a reference truth set.
Classify every returned location: command step, executor use, workflow executor parameter/matrix value, or native namespace error adjudicated by config process. Fail on every unclassified location.
For a workflow executor parameter, the source owner is the invoked job declaration name, not the workflow; repeated owner-target pairs deduplicate like every existing L2 pair.
Construct local command/executor truth from classified native answers, then combine compiler-attested workflow/job/requires truth. Never use the scanner-selected local pair set as recall denominator.

For same-name command/job collisions, references may also include the workflow job entry. Record this as an oracle error only after compiler adjudication of the command expansion; fail if a collision lacks that adjudication.
Grade the complete L2 truth even if the new parameter pairs lower recall. Do not tune on holdouts, omit a family or relabel a namespace error as a valid command pair.
P-T1/T-R7 admits the pinned vendor server at A only for evaluated, complete reference population; L3 remains held for D19.
